name: DeltaPrime
rootCause: Another day, another private key compromise. DeltaPrime Blue on Arbitrum suffers $5.98 million loss in private key compromise. Whispers of a notorious nation-state hacker group are already circulating through the cryptosphere.

descriptions.text: Another day, another private key compromise. DeltaPrime Blue on Arbitrum suffers $5.98 million loss in private key compromise. Whispers of a notorious nation-state hacker group are already circulating through the cryptosphere.

DeFi project DeltaPrime has officially confirmed on platform X that a security incident occurred. DeltaPrime Blue (Arbitrum) was attacked and drained for $5.98M. This was due to a compromised private key.

DeltaPrime's Arbitrum deployment was drained on 2024-09-16 after an attacker obtained the proxy-admin key and upgraded live contracts to malicious logic. Public reports place the loss at roughly $5.98 million to $6 million. A single key still controlled upgrade authority for DeltaPrime's Arbitrum deployment. Once that key was compromised, the attacker could replace the trusted implementation behind the live proxies and drain the pools. The evidence does not establish how the key was stolen.
